### Added

- *(operator)* Take agent-platform-operator 0.3.x, which records the last revision of an organization's file in [#1349](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1349) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson)
- *(organizations)* Erase an organization applied from git only once its delete pull request merged in [#1351](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1351) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson)
- *(organizations)* Serve an organization's OpenAI ModelConfig on the listener when model-manager serves models in [#1354](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1354) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson)
- Ship the default agent (General Assistant) and the platform skills with the chart in [#1265](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1265) by [@Rotfuks](https://github.com/Rotfuks)

### Changed

- *(deps)* Update gsoci.azurecr.io/giantswarm/agent-manager docker tag to v2.23.2 in [#1348](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1348) by [@renovate[bot]](https://github.com/renovate[bot])
- *(deps)* Update gsoci.azurecr.io/giantswarm/agent-manager docker tag to v2.24.0 in [#1370](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1370) by [@renovate[bot]](https://github.com/renovate[bot])
- Render every component on a schedule against main and the latest releases in [#1377](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1377) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians)

### Fixed

- *(organizations)* Organization admins write credential Secrets they cannot read in [#1352](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1352) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson)
- *(organizations)* A delete answered with the Secret needs get on it in [#1356](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1356) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson)
- Bound PostgreSQL WAL retained by replication slots in [#1359](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1359) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(tenants)* Let every organization member read its members in [#1369](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1369) by [@fiunchinho](https://github.com/fiunchinho)


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/compare/v4.178.0...v4.179.0
